claims: Continue mechanical ventilation with current settings, monitoring respiratory mechanics and oxygenation.
Monitor blood glucose closely and treat hyperglycemia per sliding-scale insulin protocol.
Obtain repeat blood cultures and consider broad-spectrum antibiotics for suspected infection given leukocytosis and fever.
Continue insulin therapy for glycemic control.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit; consider transfusion if anemia worsens or symptomatic.
Perform daily assessment of sedation and delirium using RASS and CAM-ICU.
Provide pressure ulcer care and repositioning for stage 1 pressure ulcer.
Monitor renal function with serum creatinine and urine output.
Continue acetaminophen as needed for fever/pain.
Maintain venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with sequential compression devices or pharmacologic prophylaxis as appropriate.
